mechanism: Both drugs affect bone metabolism through different pathways; estradiol enhances bone formation while alendronate inhibits bone resorption, with potential for additive effects on bone density and altered calcium/phosphate homeostasis.
action: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and magnesium levels periodically; ensure adequate vitamin D and calcium supplementation; separate alendronate administration from other medications by at least 30 minutes and maintain upright posture to minimize GI irritation.
